---
description: Write the shortest join paths between two or more tables, as a DBML slice.
title: ichnos join-path
---

`ichnos join-path` writes the shortest join paths between two or more tables, as a DBML slice.
The paths are the core of the slice, which ichnos never cuts.

## Usage

```{python}
#| label: help
#| echo: false
from _scripts.example import ichnos

ichnos("join-path", "--help")
```

## Example

```{python}
#| label: example
#| echo: false
from _scripts.example import ichnos

ichnos("join-path", "queries", "SALES.ORDERS", "INV.PRODUCTS", "--budget", "2500")
```
